result.fundName: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 4.13% (21.05% vs 16.92%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Small Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.34 vs benchmark 1.01, Sortino 1.72.
Defensive profile: beta 0.73 with 23% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 7.36% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.07).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -19.43% vs benchmark -30.93%.
Rolling return range spans 17.76% to 26.33% (8.57 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
